text: Subsonus Tag is a battery-powered acoustic positioning transponder that operates with the Subsonus USBL. It features an integrated battery, wireless charging, and a pressure-tolerant display, with ultra-low-power consumption enabling up to 18 months of operation on a single charge. ITAR-free.

description: Eyebrow label above the Key Features heading
H2 heading of the Key Features section

text: A revolutionary acoustic processing architecture achieves up to 18 months of battery life in slow-update applications.
Multiple tags can be deployed in the same area and tracked from a single surface Subsonus unit, each with a unique, nameable address for easy identification.
A pressure-tolerant electronic paper display lets divers receive and respond to messages from the surface, consuming no power between screen updates.
Total encapsulation of electronics and batteries delivers unparalleled reliability with no servicing required.
Qi-compatible wireless charging means no connectors are needed, and tags can be configured and updated from a smartphone over Bluetooth.
